steps.title: Refactor PullToRefreshLayout Init Code
steps.description: Simplify casting logic inside init() because headerView is now natively recognized as LinearLayout.

steps.description: Confirm dual arc pulsing logic and onDraw performance are optimal.

steps.description: Ensure onInterceptTouchEvent and onTouchEvent in PullToRefreshLayout do not conflict with list scrolls.
